core.headline: Detached house with indoor pool and 2.1 acres, Pilgrims Way
core.summary: Detached house with indoor swimming pool, triple garage and 2.1 acres on Pilgrims Way, Wrotham, within the Kent Downs National Landscape and Metropolitan Green Belt. Guide Price £1,250,000 freehold.
core.listing:
A detached house on a 2.1-acre plot on Pilgrims Way, Wrotham, with an indoor swimming pool and triple garage. The property is within the Kent Downs National Landscape and the Metropolitan Green Belt.

The house was built in 1987 and provides four bedrooms, three bathrooms and three reception rooms. Standard construction.

The accommodation includes an indoor swimming pool and three reception rooms on the ground floor.

The kitchen and family space are configured across the ground floor.

Four bedrooms are arranged on the first floor, with three bathrooms serving the accommodation.

The 2.1-acre plot includes gardens and grounds, with a triple garage and driveway parking.

Pilgrims Way, Wrotham, is in the parish of Wrotham in the borough of Tonbridge and Malling.

Guide Price £1,250,000. Freehold. Council Tax Band G (Tonbridge and Malling Borough Council). EPC rating D. Construction: Standard. Electricity: Mains. Water: Mains (metered). Sewerage: Mains. Heating: Oil-fired central heating. Broadband: FTTC. Mobile signal: Good outdoor coverage on major networks. Parking: Driveway. The property is within the Kent Downs National Landscape and the Metropolitan Green Belt. Building safety, rights and easements, flooding, coastal erosion, planning, accessibility, coalfield and mining: None known.
